title: Governing the Edge: Automating Commercial Property and Casualty Insurance Underwriting via a Hybrid Local-Cloud Multi-Agent Framework
abstract: arXiv:2609.37454v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Underwriters in commercial Property and Casualty (P&C) insurance spend 30 to 40% of their time on administrative work rather than risk judgment, and a single submission takes about 40 minutes by hand. We present Governing the Edge, a multi-agent framework for that layer, organized around a data-residency constraint: sensitive submission data must not leave the perimeter. Eleven agents and two deterministic control nodes, one a human-escalation interrupt, form a 13-node LangGraph workflow across two tiers. Agents touching raw submissions run locally on Gemma 2, each bound through a tool interface logging every invocation (synthetic stubs in the current prototype); only anonymized scores and non-identifying fields cross to Claude Sonnet in the cloud. translated_title: 边缘治理：基于混合本地-云端多智能体框架实现商业财产与意外伤害保险承保自动化
translated_abstract: 商业财产与意外伤害保险的承保人员将30%至40%的时间花费在行政事务而非风险判断上，且一份投保申请人工处理约需40分钟。我们提出了“边缘治理”，这是一个面向该环节的多智能体框架，其组织核心是数据驻留约束：敏感的投保数据不得离开安全边界。十一个智能体和两个确定性控制节点（其中一个是人工升级中断节点）构成了一个跨两层的13节点LangGraph工作流。接触原始投保数据的智能体在本地通过Gemma 2运行，每个智能体都通过一个记录每次调用的工具接口进行绑定（当前原型中使用合成桩）；只有匿名化的评分和非识别性字段才会传输到云端的Claude Sonnet。合规规则被编码为图边的条件，因此不合规的投保申请永远不会进入定价环节。我们完整走查了一个端到端场景，即一份商业车险投保申请，其……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种混合本地-云端多智能体框架“边缘治理”，通过在本地使用Gemma 2处理敏感投保数据、仅向云端传输匿名化信息的架构设计，在满足数据驻留合规约束的前提下实现了商业财产与意外伤害保险承保流程的自动化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes "Governing the Edge," a hybrid local-cloud multi-agent framework that automates commercial P&C insurance underwriting while enforcing data-residency compliance by processing sensitive submissions locally with Gemma 2 and sending only anonymized scores to cloud-based Claude Sonnet.
